spring: both blades 15 N squeezed / 21 N open from one 0.7 wire spring on a rod (L 44 -> 34); the spring force stays inside the carriers; needs two crossing arms
one spring per blade in the wall
the -X wall meets the park bisector (X + u >= -30.6): 13 mm of spring at the blade's height; 15 N with a 5 mm stroke there needs a 0.7 wire at ~950 MPa (over 0.45 UTS) or a 2x force rise (servo x2)
servo: shaft along Y under the grip (chosen)
20 thick in u (u -12.5..7.5), long side along +X: inside the bay wedge and the park bisector with 1.1 / 3.5 mm; the cam beside the blades; MG995 x3.9 on 2.3 kg.cm
shaft along u, cam in the X-Y plane
the 40.7 body hangs from u ~0 to u -45: crosses the park bisector X + u = -32 by ~25 mm at X -10 (the parked heads collide) unless the heads differ in Y; rejected
cut: no joint at the highest moment (5.3 / 6.8 N.m at the plate); 1 part, fits 110 x 90 x 125

a printed-flat plate (better rack teeth) and 4 M3 inserts at the plate: the joint carries ~190..490 N per bolt pair at the moment, +6 g, one more fit; kept as the fallback if the one-piece print fails the teeth

changes: open blade position inner faces +-11.0 (concept 10.5): a 0.8 rib into the grip pocket must clear the latched tab's outer face (10) on the way in (the latch's +-11 open; the tab's 1.0 chamfer cams a 1.0 head offset); stroke 5.0 per blade

one crossed spring (15 N squeezed per blade, L 44 -> 34) instead of one spring per blade: the -X blade has 13 mm to the park bisector (the two parked heads), where a 15 N spring would need > 950 MPa (alternatives)

a passive m1 pinion between racks on the two carriers locks their common mode: a lateral load on the cartridge goes to the body, not the cam or the spline (with free blades the cam base would take it)
blades 12 wide (Y 159..171; the latch's 13): 1.5 clear of the hall package at Y 157 (the tab magnet's spot, z_T + 8); the rib (7.7 wide) is unchanged
623ZZ roller followers on the carriers (no sliding at the cam): the servo needs 2.3 kg.cm peak (concept 1.98 average with mu 0.3 on 19.5 N)

head below the insert-lane keep-out's Z 111.5 at the drone (servo bottom u -12.5 -> Z 98.8 at the commanded insert): nothing of the catch (Z >= 154), the mast (Z <= 44) or the bays (60 deg away) is there; the structure keeps Z < 111.5 free (to the hub)
